admission.justification: Catalog resolution, scoped settings, repository authority, host-owned mode acceptance, feature checks, note composition, repeat stability and bound server definitions jointly preserve an applied host launch. The mode route shares discovery and create with other fields while Paseo retains acceptance.

guarantee: A new role launch resolves choices against Paseo’s fresh answer and uses the last successful saved answer for unavailable catalog parts. Before creation, the product refuses an unoffered provider, model or effort when the corresponding offering is known, and refuses an unoffered permitted feature or invalid feature value when the relevant offering is known. The resolver still applies the non-mode rules for incompatible combinations. If neither a fresh nor a saved answer is available for a catalog part, its offering check leaves the choice unchecked. Independently of whether feature offerings are known, a start-call feature key that governs permissions or is unclassified is refused. Permission-bearing features belong to authorized user settings or the host profile. Resolved launch fields reach the create call. For mode, an explicit dashboard choice precedes the applicable host profile and matching settings row. If none names a mode, an advertised host default applies only when the modes are known and the host advertises one. With no resulting choice, create omits modeId. A named unlisted mode reaches Paseo unchanged. Paseo decides which mode it can apply. The receipt records the observed mode, and the replay request retains the create payload. A received report that the provider rejects tool servers withholds the task-bound server definition. The launch supplies the definition when the provider's support is confirmed or unreported. The definition and the applicable startup grant are outbound creation inputs. Ordinary Codex starts grant the ordered tool allowlist of the seat's role on the bound server, and ordinary Claude starts grant server_info. Host acceptance, exclusion of independently configured servers and first-turn consumption require separate evidence.
title: launch-choices-resolve-against-host-offerings
